---
format:
    gfm:
        default-image-extension: ".png"
always_allow_html: true
execute:
    cache: true
    freeze: auto
    dir: .meta
knitr:
    opts_chunk:
        collapse: true
        comment: "#>"
        dpi: 1280
        fig.height: 6
        out.width: 100%
---
